visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a young woman with short, dark bobbed hair standing on a brightly lit stage. She is wearing a black spaghetti-strap crop top, a black tiered tutu-style skirt with a wide belt, and a multi-strand pearl necklace. In the background, a large LED screen displays "2025 YILAN." She adjusts the front of her skirt with both hands while looking towards the camera with a slight smile. (2) As the music picks up, she begins a choreographed dance routine. She moves her arms in a sharp, rhythmic fashion, at one point bringing her hands up to her head. Her facial expressions are highly animated, transitioning from a playful wink to a wide smile. The stage lighting shifts dynamically between vibrant green and cool blue hues, while artificial smoke swirls around the stage. (3) The camera angle changes frequently through quick cuts, capturing her from different eye-level perspectives. She performs a series of hip-swaying movements and intricate hand gestures, pointing outwards and then bringing her hands back to her waist. The background LED screen continues to flash colorful patterns that synchronize with her movements. (4) She executes a playful "binoculars" gesture by circling her fingers around her eyes. She then continues with a sequence of fluid arm rolls and rhythmic steps across the stage. The lighting remains high-contrast, with sharp spotlights cutting through the smoke-filled environment, highlighting the texture of her black outfit and the shimmer of her necklace. (5) The final sequence shows her completing the dance with a high-energy series of hair flips and arm extensions. She maintains strong eye contact with the lens, exuding confidence and charisma. The editing pace is fast, matching the upbeat tempo. She concludes with a final centered pose, smiling broadly as the lights momentarily brighten before the clip ends.
